_help.about: Samsung Frame art list, read by get.py. Keys starting with _ are ignored, so _note etc. can hold your own comments.
_help.works: Paintings to fetch: Wikimedia Commons first, then the Met, Art Institute of Chicago, Cleveland Museum of Art and WikiArt when Commons has nothing big enough. Output: art/<Artist> (<year>) - <Title>.jpg
_help.manual: Works you add to art/ yourself, named like the others; the review page shows which are there.

fields.artist: full name, as it should appear in the filename
fields.year: used in the filename and to tell versions of a work apart
fields.title: used in the filename and to find the work (required)
fields.queries: extra search terms: alternate or original-language titles
fields.exclude: optional regex; source filenames matching it are look-alikes, never this work
fields.match: optional: name a source must contain, if not the artist's last word (e.g. Rembrandt)
fields.file: optional: use this exact Commons file ("File:...") instead of searching
fields.local: optional: use a file on disk instead (path relative to this folder)
fields.anchor: optional crop position: 0 = left/top, 0.5 = centre, 1 = right/bottom (default: automatic)
fields.url: optional: download this image URL (any site) instead of searching
